overall: UAT candidates implemented; physical acceptance and Production gate remain open

work_items.name: Separate Android apps
work_items.evidence: Dedicated Retail/Restaurant entry points, Android projects, application IDs, fixed HTTPS UAT origins, product icons; shared original Takeaway default retained. Production tasks intentionally refused.

work_items.name: Employee, company, branch and device
work_items.evidence: Business-code login, encrypted native credentials, server-signed product/branch context, role-based routes, branch switching and scoped Counter pairing. No automatic UAT admin login.

work_items.name: Retail workflows
work_items.evidence: Existing sale/variant/barcode/intake/category/photo/hold/refund/shift/transfer/SKU report and CRM routes reused, preserving backend price/permission/stock rules. No Retail source or transaction flags changed.

work_items.name: Restaurant workflows
work_items.evidence: POS, takeaway, tables/customer QR, order/session checkout, legacy order staff, shift close, KDS/pickup, CRM. Customer QR uses public UAT origin. Branch administration intentionally opens the authenticated web back office.

work_items.name: Phone, tablet and peripherals
work_items.evidence: Phone catalog/cart/payment steps for both products, tablet layout, existing camera scanner, scoped image origins, Bluetooth selection/test/Thai raster receipt, Android print-service fallback for HTML bills; no claim of physical printer success.

work_items.name: Network interruption and recovery
work_items.evidence: Encrypted scoped cart restore; online-only writes; exact durable request replay for idempotent POS financial endpoints and Restaurant paid orders; wrong scope/changed payload/new writes blocked while pending; pending provider payment cannot be dismissed. Ambiguous dining checkout is queried, never blindly replayed. If no authoritative outcome is available, manager/server reconciliation is required; no destructive discard.

work_items.name: Build, verification and UAT delivery
work_items.evidence: VersionCode 10002, debug APK builds, TypeScript, native/web builds, targeted mock-browser checks, Gradle unit task/lint, signature verification, generated SHA256 manifests. APKs remain local, not uploaded or installed.

work_items.name: Production preparation
work_items.evidence: Per-product release gate and update/rollback procedure below. Production signing key provisioning, backup verification, physical acceptance and rollout authorization remain required. Release build guard is intentionally active.

verification.mock_browser: Restaurant 7 passed; Retail 5 passed with 2 Restaurant-only skips. Targeted recovery/cart/context cases rechecked after integration fixes.
coverage: actual POS cart UI restore after reload
lost response exact request replay after reload
pending provider payment cannot be acknowledged
dining checkout does not retry on unknown outcome
verification.limits: Mock HTTP tests do not prove live payment, stock, permissions or Android hardware acceptance. Generated Android unit tests are compilation checks, not business acceptance.
verification.android_devices: adb devices -l returned no connected device
verification.known_build_warnings: Existing large bundle, flatDir/deprecation and v1 META-INF signature metadata warnings; v2 APK signature verifies.

uat_install: Choose only the APK for the selected product; manifests are beside APKs in releases/uat/native-pos-0.1.0-uat.2.
Compare SHA256 and signing certificate against the operator's approved release. Install over the existing same-package UAT app; do not uninstall or clear data to bypass a certificate mismatch.
Use the company's real scoped test employee and Counter PIN. Confirm branch before transactions; do not use Platform/Super Admin.
If a pending transaction banner appears, restore the original employee/branch and inspect the existing result before accepting any new money.
A print error is not a payment failure. Reprint the existing sale, never create a replacement sale to obtain a receipt.

physical_gate_per_product.check: Install and update from uat.1 without losing encrypted session/cart or pending transaction
Actual employee permissions, cross-company and cross-branch denial, Counter pairing/renewal/revocation
Retail exact barcode/variant, product/category/photo, stock intake/transfer, hold/resume, price changes, sale/refund/shift totals
Restaurant tables/QR order, KDS, takeaway, cancel approval, checkout/refund and receipt totals
Phone/tablet orientation, keyboard, Back/background, camera denial/retry and external scanner
Thai 80mm receipt, QR bill/Android Print Service, paper out, Bluetooth revoke/reconnect and cash drawer
Network cut before send/after server commit, force-close/relaunch, exact retry without duplicate sale/stock/payment
Provider test PromptPay confirmation/expiry, unresolved payment and refund; compare backend evidence rather than UI success alone

required: Accept physical gate separately for each product
Assign release signing owner; create production key outside repository with protected offline backup and recovery proof
Approve Production origin and server readiness; never reuse UAT data/credentials automatically
Implement and audit the separately authorized Production build configuration
Approve data backup and restore evidence, payment/provider live configuration, staff permissions and per-branch rollout
Record owner approval, APK/AAB hash, certificate fingerprint, source commit and rollback candidate

rollback: Stop new transactions; retain app data and list every unresolved request with its original employee/branch/idempotency key.
Reconcile pending outcomes on the server before app replacement. Never clear a pending request solely because the UI timed out.
Use last-known-good source signed with the same application certificate and a higher versionCode (forward rollback). Do not uninstall or force downgrade over pending encrypted data.
Confirm schema/storage compatibility and perform a restore exercise before release. This native change introduces no database migration or server rollback step.
